transcript: Speaker A: Kya kehte the tum? [What did you use to say?] Speaker B: Tumhe theek se English bhi nahi aati hai. Ghar ka kaam karo Shreya. Yeh job-vob tumhare bas ki baat nahi hai. [You don't even know English properly. Do housework, Shreya. This job stuff is not your cup of tea.] Speaker A: You know what? I got a job. They called me today. And you know what they said? "Shreya, your English communication skills really impressed us." Speaker B: Are! Tumne itni acchi English kaise seekh li? [Oh! How did you learn such good English?] Speaker A: Mere ek friend ne kaha SpeakX app download kar lo. Sirf do weeks hue hain is app ko use karte hue. Aap jab office jaate the, main har din free time pe 10 se 15 minute practice kar leti thi. Jab thoda confidence aaya, toh AI teacher ne mujhe kuch interview questions practice karaye. Jaise "Tell me about yourself", "Why do you want this job?", sab kuch. Aur galti karo toh turant correct kar deti hai, bina judge kiye. Aur aise hi meri English bolne mein fluency bhi aa gayi aur confidence bhi. Maine kuch jobs pe bhi apply kiya, and believe me, English acchi hone ki wajah se meri selection bhi ho gayi. [A friend of mine told me to download the SpeakX app. It's only been two weeks using this app. When you went to the office, I would practice for 10 to 15 minutes in my free time every day. When I got a little confidence, the AI teacher made me practice some interview questions. Like "Tell me about yourself", "Why do you want this job?", everything. And if you make a mistake, it corrects you immediately, without judging. And just like that, I got fluency and confidence in speaking English. I also applied for some jobs, and believe me, because my English was good, I got selected.] Speaker B: Are wah! Phir toh yeh app bohot mehenga hoga na? [Oh wow! Then this app must be very expensive, right?] Speaker A: Sirf 2 rupaye mein 7 din ka trial hai. [It's a 7-day trial for just 2 rupees.] Speaker B: Nice! Meri bhi promotion ruki hui hai, English theek karni padegi. Main bhi download kar leta hoon SpeakX app. [Nice! My promotion is also stuck, I need to improve my English. I will also download the SpeakX app.]
